question: 整个平台售价最高的商品属于哪个分类？最高价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY max_price DESC, c.id LIMIT 1
pred_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.price AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 'active' ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1
initial_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.price AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 'active' ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1
